purpose: Test Ball Radar's recurrent-memory idea in the current masked, variable-slot possession task
models: per-player trajectory encoder plus two-layer bidirectional LSTM
same recurrent memory combined with the existing dilated temporal CNN
inference: Whole halves for recurrent models, never independent chunks with reset recurrent memory. Team-symmetric averaged predictions.
criterion: Same official spellF1 and frozen decoders as V10. No modifications to ongoing V13 folds; this is a separate exploratory experiment.
public_policy: No competition ground truth, manual annotations or public scoring
